description: Get the unified diff of a pull request, one page of whole files at a time (page, limit; default 50 files, so a pull request of ordinary size comes back whole). When files follow the page, the output ends with a truncation marker naming the next page. Pass an optional file_path to receive only the hunks for that file (match is exact on either the pre- or post-rename path); file_path ignores page and limit. Use list_pull_request_files first to discover the file paths in the PR.

file_path.description: Optional. Return only the diff section for this file (matched on the diff --git boundary). Omit for the page of files.

limit.description: Files per page (default 50; a larger limit than the instance maximum is refused).

name: get_pull_request_diff
